messages:
Taylor V: Morning team, excited to start! Quick snag: clicked the Okta invite and it opened the device-trust prompt then errored with 'Unexpected credential type' during passkey enrollment. I'm on a company Win10 laptop (Edge) and can't use the YubiKey yet (waiting shipment). Also 1Password invite not in my inbox. Who can help with a temporary access route?

Jordan (IT): Hey Taylor  welcome! That Edge error usually means the browser is forcing enterprise certificates that break WebAuthn. Can you try the invite in Chrome incognito or on your phone with Okta Verify? Also confirm the invite email (aliases can cause trouble).

Taylor V: Invite sent to taylor.v@redwood.dev. Tried Chrome incognito and got the same 'Unexpected credential type' in the devtools console: `TypeError: Failed to register a credential: The provided authenticator data is not supported.`

Jordan (IT): Thanks. Two quick workarounds: 1) I can generate a one-time magic link that bypasses the device-trust/passkey step so you can finish setup and add SMS/Okta Verify temporarily. 2) I can add you to a 'new-hires-temp' Google group for docs/calendar in the meantime. Which do you prefer?

Taylor V: Magic link please. Also add me to new-hires-temp so I can see onboarding calendar items.

Priya - People Ops: Adding you to new-hires-temp now. 1Password seats had a short provisioning queue this morning  I've requested a seat for you (PL-1320) and escalated with vendor.

SecOps Bot: [automated] Ticket created: IT-56012  "Win10 Edge WebAuthn failure for taylor.v@redwood.dev". Assigned to Jordan (IT).

Jordan (IT): Sent the one-time magic link via DM (expires 12h). Also left a note to Ops to expedite YubiKey shipping. Use the magic link in a private window and enroll Okta Verify (phone) as temporary MFA.

Taylor V: Magic link worked! Account created. Enrolled Okta Verify on iPhone and set SMS fallback. I can sign in now. Still no 1Password invite but I can access the onboarding docs.

Priya - People Ops: Vendor confirmed 1Password seat provisioned (PL-1320). You should get the invite within ~10 mins. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Taylor V: Got 1Password invite and set up vault access. Thanks Jordan and Priya. Quick follow-up: add a note if the Edge cert chain needs a corp exception so future hires don't hit this?

Jordan (IT): Will file an infra note. Follow-up ticket IT-56013 created to add a KB entry: "Edge/Win WebAuthn troubleshooting for new hires". If you want a YubiKey once it arrives we can swap you from Okta Verify to hardware-only. Enjoy your first day!
